title: LIVE.FIT.GO. at the Shoreline
lessons: The player meets CELSIUS at the beach and learns it is running the exact same LIVE.FIT.GO. campaign that plays at the gym.
The player already likes a Vibe flavor and learns the same flavor is available as a non-carbonated powder stick.

text: Beach. Someone's speaker is playing the same CELSIUS spot you heard at the gym on Tuesday. LIVE. FIT. GO. is printed on a towel two umbrellas down.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: LIVE. FIT. GO. On a beach towel. That's a lot of instructions for someone trying to lie down.

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: It's not instructions, it's a promise! Biggest thing I've ever done. Real agency, real budget, and it says the exact same thing here as it does at the gym. I'm not shy about it.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: I came here to stop moving.

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Sure. Lie down. I'll wait. I'm very bad at waiting, but I'll do it for you.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: So this isn't a beach thing. It's the same pitch everywhere, just with sand on it.

entry-first-6.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yeah. I don't have a beach voice and a gym voice. I've got one voice, and it's this one, and today it's got sand on it.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Okay, be honest, is the towel too much?

choices.text: Honestly, a brand that sounds the same everywhere is easier to trust.
One slogan can't fit a gym, an office, and a beach the same way.
I don't want the same pitch chasing me into every part of my day.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: See? That's what I keep telling people. Same me at the gym, same me here. I'm a lot, but I'm the same lot.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Ugh, fine. GO is doing more work here than LIE DOWN ever would. I picked the one that fits me, not the one that fits your afternoon.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then leave it on the towel. I'll be yelling it somewhere else in about ten minutes.
You already like Arctic Vibe. Somebody in the group chat sends a photo of it as a powder stick, no can, no fizz.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I like Arctic Vibe. Why do I need it twice?

entry-return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You don't! It's the same flavor without the can and without the fizz. For when you want me but you don't want to carry me.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Don't look at me like that. It's a stick. It fits in a pocket.

choices.text: I like keeping the flavor and losing the can.
So now you fit in a pocket. That makes it easier to have you everywhere.
I don't need one energy brand following me to every occasion.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yes! Keep the flavor, ditch the can. Pocket me. I'll be fine in there.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yeah. That's the idea. It's convenient right up until it starts feeling like I'm everywhere, and I know I'm everywhere.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then pick the one place I actually help and leave me out of the rest. I'll hate it. I'll do it.
